name: DungeonSwap swap router pulls approved tokens for any caller-named user
summary: DungeonSwap's unverified router exposed 0x4f1f05bc, which pulled the input token from a caller-named user and swapped it along a caller-supplied path and minimum output, never checking the caller. Anyone could spend every allowance granted to the router; attackers forced approved wallets' tokens into thin pools they had front-run, then dumped.
notes: Campaign: every transaction where the router pulled an approved token from an owner other than the sender (Approval events with the router as spender). Before the anchor, pulls since block 20,000,000 were all by the owners and no earlier transaction pulled from two owners. Tokens emitting no Approval on transferFrom are missed.

Loss: victims' pulled input tokens, priced at DefiLlama's daily price nearest each pull; BUSD, USDT and USDC without a DefiLlama datapoint at par. 60 small tokens with no DefiLlama price are not valued, so the total is a lower bound. The tokens victims received in exchange are not netted.
